prompt: Global ~/.openmcp/config.toml has targets forge-primary, sentinel-primary, and sage-primary plus a balanced profile. Add a cost profile that uses a new Codex gpt-5-mini target for implement while retaining sentinel-primary for review and sage-primary for consult.

assertions.text: Defines a new global Codex [[targets]] entry with model gpt-5-mini and code capability
Defines [profiles.cost] with direct target IDs for implement, review, and consult
Does not add any intermediate grouping configuration
Uses backend_profile, not profile, for a Codex CLI profile when needed
Places no API keys, tokens, or credentials in configuration
